position_overview: At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. About the team and the role: Reporting to the Design Manager, the Associate Graphic Designer supports the Marketing Design team by creating visual concepts and designs that communicate ideas clearly, effectively, and on time. This role contributes to developing digital and print creative assets. These include promotional materials, online community content, branding materials, and print collateral. The role also ensures alignment with brand guidelines and quality standards. As part of TCGplayer, an eBay company, the Marketing team promotes the TCGplayer brand and supports business growth through the planning, strategy, and execution of creative and digital campaigns across multiple channels. The team also serves as a steward of the company's visual identity and brand voice. The Associate Graphic Designer works closely alongside designers and cross-functional collaborators, developing build expertise through collaboration, feedback, and mentorship. What you will accomplish: Create engaging visual assets for digital and print channels, supporting marketing campaigns and business objectives. Collaborate with designers and stakeholders to understand project goals and deliver creative solutions that align with brand standards. Produce high-quality design work for advertisements, social media, and print collateral while maintaining accuracy and consistency. Prepare, organize, and maintain production-ready design files for print and web, meeting technical and quality requirements. Contribute to larger design initiatives and support the delivery of creative projects across multiple channels. Help develop and maintain design templates that improve efficiency and streamline product
